question: Can a legal synchronous RawNode history consume the automatic-exit application trigger during a failed transfer and reach an equal full protocol/storage state across a fair post-abort tick period without an exit entry?
rationale: Candidate bb06765563e7461e80257e50a4cd3dc1: three real bootstrapped RawNodes; actual messages only, storage before sends, committed configurations applied before Advance. Drop only actual transfer TimeoutNow messages until transfer timeout, then reliable transport. Capture all RawNode scalar/container state and dispatch addresses, with storage separately and logger objects excluded.
